sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam.

Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male vagrant sleeping inside; management had tried multiple times to wake him and he refused to leave. Commencing patrol to McDonald's Queen Street.

Arrived at the location; the male was sleeping in-store. After many attempts to wake him he finally sat up, falsely claiming he had an order while scrolling through YouTube. He eventually left, directing racial abuse at the team on his way out, saying we are 'not for the people'; we told him to have a good morning. Standing by maintaining security presence.
Continuing towards the corner of Victoria Street and Federal Street.

Arrived at the location; completed welfare checks on 77 Convenience Store, Eighty Fed, Amelia Cafe, The Coffee Club, the news agency and Subway, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining security presence.
Welfare check on Elliott Carpark and Darby Street, all clear, no issues to report; standing by maintaining presence while awaiting response calls.
Welfare check within the area on businesses that are open, all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Durham Street West and East, all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol.
All clear; continuing patrol down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues to report; standing by maintaining security presence while awaiting response calls.
Welfare check at Q Convenience Store, all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrol.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues.
Commencing sweep within the area while remaining vigilant.
Commercial Bay all clear, no further issues; continuing patrol towards Lower Albert Street. Welfare check at Woolworths and Aotea Gifts, all clear, no issues to report.
All clear from both locations; patrolling up Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear; heading towards St Patrick's Cathedral.
Arrived at St Patrick's Cathedral; commencing sweep within the area.
All clear, no issues to report; standing by maintaining security presence.
Continuing patrol through Federal Street towards Victoria Street.
Received a response call from Celine regarding a female vagrant sleeping at the entrance of Elliott Carpark with her pants down; heading to Elliott Street to assist.

Arrived at the location; the female vagrant was nowhere to be seen. Swept Elliott Carpark with no sighting, then spoke with the owner at Celine's, who said everything is okay. Standing by maintaining security presence.
Heading to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone.
Received a response call from Montblanc regarding a male vagrant sitting in front of the store hassling people for money; commencing patrol down Queen Street.
Arrived at the location; the male was seen fleeing from in front of Montblanc as we approached. Standing by maintaining security presence.
Heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Received a response call from Bag Planet regarding two males running away from the store after a phone repair; commencing patrol.

Arrived at the location; store management said the pair had come in 1–2 hours earlier to have a phone fixed, then returned to retrieve the phone and ran off without paying, heading towards Starbucks. Commencing patrol down Queen Street while remaining vigilant.
Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male vagrant sleeping in front of the store.
Arrived at the location; the male vagrant was still on site sleeping. Asked nicely to vacate elsewhere, the vagrant complied and moved on. Standing by maintaining security presence.
Heading back to Headquarters to wait for handover.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam.
Afternoon Shift deployed; commencing debrief before patrols, charging the Ops Phone in the process.
Victoria Street all clear, no issues; welfare check on businesses in the area; patrolling down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing sweep of the area (14:49–15:05).

Full sweep of Freyberg Place, Chancery Street and Square and O'Connell Street; welfare check on all businesses in the area, all clear. Received a call from ex-management regarding a male vagrant in front of BNZ shouting and swearing in public; en route to the location.

Arrived at the location and approached the vagrant to ask what had happened. He told us he was fine until a group of members of the public started yelling at him and calling him inappropriate names, prompting his behaviour. No issues to report; the vagrant has settled down and promised he will no longer act like that in a public area. Standing by at Mothership (until 15:35).
Full sweep of Shortland Street; welfare check at The North Face, Taco Bell, Shortland Mart, Haven Mart and Mothership, all clear; heading back to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage (shown on the work camera) (15:55–17:00).
Received a call from management to maintain presence at Darby station; gearing up and heading to the location.
Arrived at the location; standing by maintaining presence for assistance while the second guard attends a response call.
Second guard arrived at Darby station after assisting Police with an arrest of a male individual who attempted to steal a trolley full of products; no issues. (Photos and footage on file.)
Both guards on site maintaining presence at Darby station (17:45–18:45).
Received a call from management to attend Commercial Bay to respond to an issue; en route to the location.

Arrived at Commercial Bay and spoke with the event coordinator, who reported that the party next to them was playing loud music and had threatened the event coordinator with destroying property. Promptly confronted them and asked nicely to turn their music down due to the disturbance to the public area; they cooperated and turned their music down, no further issues. Standing by due to heavy public presence in the area (19:15–19:45).
Received a call from management to be located at Headquarters to swipe him up to Level 7; en route to the destination.
Arrived at the destination; assisting the manager with anything needed.
Travelling with management by car to TK Square to conduct a welfare check on the art gallery.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check with the event coordinator.
Welfare check of the Commercial Bay event all clear, no issues; heading back to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing 30-minute break (20:45 on break).
Break completed; awaiting guard handover in the office.
Afternoon Shift completed; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam.
Night Shift deployed; management requested the team locate to Darby station to assist with closing at 21:45.
Returned to HQ for Ethan, who is heading out to Sweat Shop.
Night Shift heading out for patrols; Ops Phone at 39%.
On standby outside Bar 101 showing presence due to a shortage of guards.
Guard has arrived; all clear, no issues at this time. Patrolling Queen Street.
Welfare check at Wyndham club — it is packed; on standby showing presence.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
On standby outside Mothership showing presence.
Heading to Commercial Bay — a large rush of Police cars heading in that direction.

Arrived at Commercial Bay; Police were surrounding a couple and appeared to have confiscated a bag that seemed to contain a hammer. A large Police presence had the situation under control, so we are heading to a response call at Bar 101.
Arrived at Bar 101; on standby showing presence (00:50 still on standby at the manager's request).
Bar 101 all clear for now, no issues.
Check-in at McDonald's Queen Street, no issues.
Check-in at Chancery Square / Freyberg Place, all clear, no issues to report; heading to HQ for a toilet break.
Responding to a call to stand by at Bar 101 due to the venue being busy.
Bar 101 closed; headed back to HQ for a guard to sign out.
On standby at Elliott Street waiting for the area to clear out.
Elliott Street / Darby Street all clear, no issues to report; heading back to HQ for a 30-minute break.
On standby at HQ charging the Ops Phone, available for any response calls.

flags: SENSITIVE: 06:53 Individual directed racial abuse at the team while being moved on from McDonald's Queen Street.
SENSITIVE: 17:33 Second guard assisted Police with an arrest (male attempting to steal a trolley full of products); photos and footage on file.
SENSITIVE: 00:17 Police incident at Commercial Bay — bag confiscated from a couple appeared to contain a hammer; Police had the scene under control, team not engaged.
CAPACITY: 23:00–23:46 Team held static presence outside Bar 101 due to a shortage of guards until the relief guard arrived.
STALE: Afternoon Shift ran 14:30–21:30 and Night Shift 21:30–06:30 (one hour earlier than the standard 22:30 changeover).
